title: Predictive Value of Coronary CT-Angiography for Cardiovascular Events and Participation in the CONFIRM2 Registry
summary: Untersuchung, wie gut eine Herz-CT (Koronar-CT-Angiographie) schwere Herzereignisse bei Patientinnen und Patienten mit Verdacht auf eine koronare Herzkrankheit vorhersagen kann.

interventions.name: all patients undergoing coronary CT angiography for suspectd CAD will be contacted after 3 years for clinical follow-up

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
all patients untergoing coronary CT angiography for suspected CAD
Exclusion criteria:
Unstable heart rhythm during scan, acute lifethreatening disease
